title: Pricing bundles orchestration and release-note cadence
creator: Avery Chen
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch for pricing and packaging changes: introduce new bundle SKUs, update per-route limits, run entitlement mapping for existing customers, and synchronize release notes and billing communications. Goal: minimize billing regressions and migration support load while enabling Sales/CS to sell new SKUs by public launch. Out of scope: changes to machine-level quotas and dedicated capacity contract terms (handled by Dedicated team).
acceptance_criteria: New SKUs available in billing system and sandbox; entitlement mapping script validated against 10 sample accounts
Billing cutoff and migration runbook reviewed and signed off by Legal and Finance
Release notes drafted and synchronized across Console, API changelog, and partner-facing docs
Sales enablement deck, objection handling FAQ, and pricing migration playbook delivered to AE and CS teams
No critical regressions in invoice generation for customers on existing plans during staging test run
rollout_plan: 2026-03-05: Freeze public-facing pricing page; announce internal embargo to Sales/CS
2026-03-10: Run entitlement mapping dry-run on staging and validate invoices (owner: Billing eng)
2026-03-13: Release notes + console changelog staged; legal sign-off acquired
2026-03-15: Sales enablement live session + recorded training distributed
2026-03-20: Production cutover and public launch; monitor metrics for 72 hours
communication_plan: Internal: #pm-pricing (Slack) for daily syncs; weekly cross-functional readout with ENG/Billing/Legal/Marketing
Sales/CS: Live enablement on 2026-03-15; handout with migration checklist and 10 common objections
External: Release notes posted to docs.redwood.ai/changelog and summarized in customer newsletter; targeted email to customers on legacy SKUs
Escalation path: Billing incident runbook with on-call Billing eng + PM + Finance contact details
launch_checklist: Finalize SKU definitions (code, display name, included units) and publish to spec (Confluence: /pricing/bundles-2026Q1)
Billing: implement SKU entries in payments system; add test invoices for each SKU
Entitlements: migration script written and smoke-tested against 10 accounts; rollback documented
Console: update plan selector UI and per-route limits in sandbox
Docs: release notes, migration guide, API changelog, and examples updated
Sales: enablement deck, pricing playbook, T-shirt sizing cheat sheet delivered
Support: create troubleshooting KB and canned responses for top 8 migration questions
Monitoring: create dashboards (token usage, invoice errors, migration errors) and set alert thresholds
Legal/Finance: sign-off on billing language and refund policy for migrations
Marketing: coordinate timing for public blog post and customer emails
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect entitlement mapping could create billing overcharges. Mitigation: run staged dry-run and require Finance approval before enabling migrations on production.
Risk: Sales confusion on how to position bundles. Mitigation: pre-recorded training + live Q&A + one-pager with competitive messaging.
Risk: Checkout or invoicing edge-cases for enterprise customers. Mitigation: run smoke invoices for top 15 customers and schedule account-level outreach if anomalies detected.
Risk: Release notes ambiguous about quota changes. Mitigation: include clear examples and an explicit migration window with rollback instructions.
